longDescription:
Improve focus and increase your productivity by listening to different ambient sounds

Also can help you to fall asleep in a noisy environment.

Features:

  • Save presets
  • Add custom sounds
  • Auto start in background
  • MPRIS integration

Included Sounds in the App:

  • Birds
  • Boat
  • City
  • Coffee Shop
  • Fireplace
  • Pink Noise
  • Rain
  • Summer Night
  • Storm
  • Stream
  • Train
  • Waves
  • White Noise
  • Wind
